question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Lonelyness'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word here is** "Lonelyness". **
 
• The** correct **spelling is **"Loneliness".**
 
• **Loneliness **is the feeling of sadness because one has no friends or company.(अकेलापन)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:* 'Lonelyness'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain all the words:

 
 
• **"Efficient" **(correctly spelled) refers to achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense(कुशल)
 
• **"Compassion"** (correctly spelled) is sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others.(दया)
 
• **"Mortality" **(correctly spelled) refers to the state of being subject to death. It often used to discuss the death rate, or the number of deaths in a certain group of people in a certain period of time.(मृत्यु दर)
